items.item_text: Current California Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT) License.
Experience maintaining equipment in proper working order.

Under the direction of the Surgical Services Supervisor and the Dentistry and Oral Surgery Service Chief, provide specialized technical support to the Dentistry Service. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, safely restraining patients for oral examinations; collecting samples for diagnostic laboratory testing; preparing and setting up operating rooms; serving as an operating room circulating technician; maintaining specialized dental and surgical equipment; and training students and residents in technical procedures such as blood collection and IV catheter placement. Responsible for general duties including set up, circulate and clean up for various dental procedures in both the dentistry suite and the operating room. Cleaning and processing of dental instruments and packs. Perform and administer treatments per clinician orders. Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary team members to support and advance the objectives of the Surgery Services.
60% - Technical Duties for Dentistry and Oral Surgery
Skill to aseptically set up an operating room with instruments and equipment.
Knowledge of dental radiographic techniques and safety.
